nodes.label: gTTS Board Voice
nodes.rationale: Piper lessac-medium has weak breathy sibilants that fail through speakers, so all card audio switched to gTTS recorded human speech verified with Whisper STT; spectral hi-ratio analysis diagnoses engine regressions without listening.

nodes.label: Piper Overwrite Lesson
nodes.rationale: Re-running the Piper generate-audio script on the full vocab silently wiped verified gTTS clips; never run it on the full vocab, and use git log on public/audio to find which commit regenerated files.

nodes.label: Voice Picker Lab
nodes.rationale: The /voice route compares current board voice, a full single-voice Piper offline set, live device voices, and a planned Voicebox clone side by side with one shared word list; the pick persists per device in localStorage and the Piper set stays comparison-only until a decision is made.

nodes.label: Whisper Verification
nodes.rationale: Whisper STT base model run 5-10 times per clip is ground truth for spoken-word accuracy, with spectral burst analysis for minimal pairs like wipe versus white that Whisper cannot distinguish.

hyperedges.label: Voice pipeline: gTTS board voice, Piper set, lab, pre-generated WAV
